scenes.heading: EXT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL ALLEY - NIGHT

lines.text: EXT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL ALLEY - NIGHT
Harper drops to her knees in the rain, pressing her hands against Cole's chest to stop the massive pool of blood spreading from his stab wound.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Cole! Stay with me, you idiot! Don't you dare close your eyes!

scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - EMERGENCY ROOM - CONTINUOUS

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - EMERGENCY ROOM - CONTINUOUS
Nurses rush out with a gurney, wheeling the 32-year-old billionaire shipping CEO inside while he gasps for air.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: He's bleeding out from a metal pipe strike, prep the trauma bay now!
EXT. WHITMORE ESTATE - STUDY - NIGHT
Jake slams a stolen corporate ledger onto the mahogany desk in front of his 58-year-old mother Diane.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: The board signed off, Mother. With Evelyn dead, we control the entire Whitmore shipping empire.
INT. WHITMORE ESTATE - STUDY - CONTINUOUS
Diane exhales a plume of cigarette smoke, a cold smile crossing her face as she looks at her 29-year-old son.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: And once Harper's signature is notarized on those transfer papers, nobody can ever prove how Evelyn really died.
EXT. HOSPITAL PARKING GARAGE - NIGHT
Mia stands by a concrete pillar wearing her post-surgery medical sling, shivering as a dark sedan pulls up beside her.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Looking for a ride out of this nightmare, Mia? Your nurse sister has bigger problems tonight.

scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - SURGICAL RECOVERY - NIGHT

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - SURGICAL RECOVERY - NIGHT
Harper stares at her blood-stained hands in the mirror, trembling as she realizes Cole took a hit meant to protect her.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: He lied about who he was for a whole year... so why am I terrified he's going to die?
INT. HOSPITAL RECOVERY ROOM - CONTINUOUS
Heart monitor flatlines with a piercing, continuous beep as nurses shout code blue over Cole's bed.
